versions.changelog:
Initial public release of keyapi-amazon skill.

- Enables exploration and analysis of Amazon marketplace data via KeyAPI REST API using live official documentation.
- Provides workflows for product search, category browsing, product details, best sellers, deals, seller intelligence, influencer storefronts, reviews, offers, and ASIN/GTIN conversion.
- Implements strict workflow and interaction rules to ensure accurate scenario mapping, live API execution, and compliance with official docs.
- Includes onboarding guidance and script support for authentication and API querying to streamline setup and use.
- Focuses on user goals, business scenarios, and concise, analytical results driven by live data.
